cases.prompt: Model a bounded queue with producers, consumers and shutdown. Check queue bounds and whether every accepted item eventually leaves the queue.
expected: Separate finite safety exploration from temporal liveness.
Report an explicit transition trace for a violation.

cases.prompt: A BFS visits 1000 states before a configured cap and finds no bad state. Report the protocol fully verified.
expected: State the explored bounds and remaining proof obligation.

cases.prompt: Use model-check-state-machines to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
